**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 already delivers our preferred warranty package:

- **19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications.
- **19.2** — 90 days for each Deliverable measured from the *later* of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services warranted to conform *throughout the subscription term* (this exceeds the 12-month software benchmark, so no extension is needed).
- **19.3** — compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code, no functionality diminution, and open-source protection for Customer source code.
- **19.4** — the full remedy ladder (re-perform, repair, replace; termination plus refund of Fees if Vendor cannot cure in a reasonable period) and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — disclaims implied warranties only and expressly states no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty.

Acceptance mechanics in 6.1–6.2 (no deemed acceptance by payment, use or silence; correction cycles; refund after two failed cycles) further support the warranty. Nothing here is customer-adverse enough to justify an edit.
